categories.name: Small Leather Articles
categories.description: Discover a curated collection of small leather goods that blend premium craftsmanship with artistic expression. From card holders to keychains, luggage tags, eyewear cases, and travel accessories, each piece is crafted from high-quality leather and enhanced with intricate prints, embossing, and handcrafted detailing. Designed for both functionality and visual distinction, these compact essentials offer refined organization, lasting durability, and a unique aesthetic that transforms everyday accessories into wearable works of art.

categories.name: Leather Bags
categories.description: Leather bags remain one of the most important categories in the accessories industry, but differentiation increasingly lies in design and execution. MCRC’s bag range is distinguished by its use of embossed leather and hand-painted artwork, creating products with a level of detail and individuality rarely found in mass-market offerings. From everyday totes and handbags to fashion-forward silhouettes, the category demonstrates how traditional leatherworking techniques can be combined with contemporary design to create products that are both commercially relevant and visually distinctive for global brands, retailers, and private label collections.

categories.name: Decor / Coin Banks
categories.description: MCRC’s décor and coin bank category represents a highly specialized segment of leather craftsmanship, transforming a material traditionally used for accessories into three-dimensional decorative products. As one of the few manufacturers with the capability to develop structured décor items in leather, MCRC offers a distinctive range that stands apart in the global market. The category extends beyond animal-inspired designs to include flowers, geometric forms, vehicles, character concepts, and custom shapes developed to suit specific themes and retail programs. Combining advanced leather molding and construction techniques, these products offer a unique alternative to conventional décor materials while creating strong differentiation for gifting, lifestyle, and specialty retail segments.

categories.name: Wallets

categories.name: Canvas Bags
categories.description: MCRC’s canvas bag category combines the strength and versatility of 14-ounce canvas with the distinctive character of the company’s hand-painted and embossed leather components. By integrating these two materials, the range offers a unique balance of durability, lightweight construction, and artistic detailing. The category spans crossbody bags, backpacks, utility bags, and everyday carry styles, providing an alternative to conventional all-canvas products through the addition of signature leather accents that enhance both appearance and product value. Designed for lifestyle, travel, and casual fashion segments, these bags reflect MCRC’s ability to blend material innovation with recognizable design identity.
categories.mobileDescription: Durable 14-ounce canvas bags enhanced with distinctive hand-painted and embossed leather components. A balance of lightweight construction, functionality, and artistic detailing.

team.name: Rakesh Chandan
team.bio: The driving force behind its journey a globally recognized leather manufacturing company. With a deep understanding of both craftsmanship and trade, he laid the foundation for a business built on quality, discipline, and long-term relationships. His vision continues to guide the company’s growth, ensuring that tradition evolves with changing global demands.

team.name: Madhu Chandan
team.bio: She leads the design and artistic direction of the company, shaping collections that reflect the unique identity of hand-painted leather craftsmanship. Her work ensures that every product is not just functional, but visually distinctive and aligned with evolving market preferences.

team.name: Shlok Chandan
team.bio: Working closely across production, quality control, and client coordination, he ensures that every product meets the expected levels of consistency, finish, and reliability. His focus lies in strengthening systems, improving efficiency, and maintaining the balance between handcrafted detail and scalable production.
